BackupFile.title: BackupFile
BackupFile.description: Metadata for a modified .bin file backup.

id.description: Unique identifier for the backup entry.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns the backup.

name.description: The name of the backed-up .bin file.

storagePath.description: The full path to the file in Firebase Storage.

size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the backup was created.

/users/{userId}/backups/{backupId}.description: Stores metadata for user-specific file backups. Authorization is based on the userId in the path.
